scenarios.requirement: A language with no error-message pattern does not read past memory when F9 reports errors
A pattern that ends inside a test does not read past memory when F9 reports errors
A pattern with fewer rows than the maximum does not read past memory when F9 reports errors
Every message pattern of a compiler the editor knows is read with its rows, warning tests and file naming, and a pattern literal added to the editor without being added to the unit's list fails
scenarios.note: pass A, compile half; red when the row splitter is stubbed off

scenarios.requirement: A pattern cut inside a ${...} token, a [...] class or a backslash, an empty pattern and one with no ${LINE} are refused with a reason naming the token; an unknown variable, rows past the fourth and a non-numeric warning column are accepted with a note
scenarios.note: pass A; red when R1, R2, R3, R4 or R8 is stubbed off (measured on scratch copies of we_errpat.c)

scenarios.requirement: A '$' that is not followed by '{' is an ordinary byte, and the classes and escapes the matcher reads today are accepted unchanged
scenarios.note: compile half only; the match half lands with pass B

scenarios.requirement: Reading any pattern built from the fuzz tokens (seeds 0 to 3999) ends, reads nothing outside the text and gives the same answer twice
scenarios.note: compile half only; the matcher-only pass lands with pass B
